sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Easter eggs and References:
  - This is a reference to the content creator Sacriel. The "42nd" is what "Sacriel" calls his subscribers. It is a reference to the naming of military platoons. The number 42, specifically, was chosen as a reference to Douglas Adams' "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy".
